title: Head-to-head retrieval quality (R@k, nDCG@k, MRR@10) on the 160-question set of the 2026-11-05 run

corpus.what: the head-to-head store: 95 collections taken from XERJ Score v2 eval worlds (synthetic records 'subject | relation | type: value | source sentence'), NOT Wikipedia
corpus.duplicated_listings: 13 listings are byte-identical in d1_select and s1b_dev (the two counting families share worlds); the store held them twice (695 duplicate records); metrics count a duplicate once, at its first rank
corpus.source: h2h-2026-11-05/raw/scenario.json (built on our ARM build host ~/blog_measure; builder in transcript 6f75f725.../agent-ae9a2d637cd141cca.jsonl)

relevance.definition: a record is relevant if it is a gold evidence record; a chunk (8 consecutive records of one collection) is relevant if it contains one. Derived on our ARM build host, never copied off: point questions = label support_fact_ids; counting (set) questions = evidence (find_facts + filter facts of every counted member) returned by executing the gold setq program with the frozen engine worker (xerj-ask serve), which reproduced every gold answer; bench OUT_OF_SCOPE-complete questions = read set of the gold SQL (records of anchor and population entities on SQL-referenced columns; entity roles recovered by rebuilding the 40 bench worlds with the frozen builder, 40/40 byte-identical). Every listing re-rendered from its world matched the stored listing (160/160), so record positions map to fact ids exactly.
relevance.headline_set: main_90 = point (54) + set_counted (36); all_101 adds the 11 bench read-set questions

metrics_definition:
ON SPARK ONLY. Scores the ranked lists (work/rankings_rag.json, work/rankings_xerj.json; no gold inside) against the gold
evidence positions (work/rel.json + work/rel_bench.json; never leave our ARM build host). Writes work/h2h_perq.json (stays on our ARM build host) and
out/h2h_retrieval_agg.json (aggregates only, safe to copy off).
Relevance: record relevant = it is a gold evidence record; chunk (8 consecutive records of one collection, the RAG unit)
relevant = it contains a relevant record. Binary gains. R@k = |relevant in top k| / |relevant|; Hit@k = any relevant in top k;
nDCG@k with log2(rank+1) discount and ideal = min(|relevant|, k) ones; MRR@10 = 1 / rank of the first relevant (0 if none in 10).
Duplicates (13 listings were stored twice) count once, at their first rank. Chunk arms are scored at record level by reading
their chunks in rank order, records in stored order inside a chunk (what the LLM read); record arms at chunk level by the rank
of the first record of each chunk.

retrieved_lists.rag: recovered from the prompts that were sent to Opus (raw/rag/<arm>/<qid>.usr), every chunk mapped back (0 unmapped); retrieval step re-run with rag_build.py's exact settings (no LLM): identical lists for 160/160 questions in all four arms; the top-5 list is the prefix of the top-10 list in 160/160
retrieved_lists.graphrag: recovered from raw/graphrag/query/<qid>.usr: the '-Sources-' text units in context order (30,873 record lines mapped, 0 unmapped); the entity, relationship and community-report sections are LLM-written text, not records, and are not scored

xerj.binary: xerj v1.0.0-rc.101 x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu release tarball (sha256 file checked)
xerj.index: h2h, 5,000 docs (one per stored record, duplicates kept), fields text (text, '[cid] record'), cid (keyword), vec (dense_vector 384, cosine, float32: no int8 opt-in)
xerj.query_text: 'collection <cid> <question>' for BM25 (as the RAG BM25 arm); bge-small of 'collection <cid>: <question>' for kNN (as the RAG embedding arm)

xerj.knn_exactness: after de-duplication XERJ kNN top-10 equals exact numpy cosine top-10 on 160/160 (overlap 1.0; the raw 0.8456 in rankings_xerj.json counts duplicate records twice)

stability_across_3_server_processes.why: tied scores are ordered by a per-process hash seed (docs/ZERO_TOKEN_DIRECTION.md on origin/main)

xerj.latency_note: rep2/rep3 = fresh server process warmed with 200 unrelated queries, each measured query executed once. A repeated identical query is answered from a result cache (took 0 ms, xerj_latency.json pass2) and must not be quoted. Laptop shared with other jobs (load average up to 24.8).

latency_cold_start_and_repeat.note: client wall = Python http.client round trip on localhost incl. JSON encode of a 384-float vector; server took = the engine's own 'took' (integer ms)

xerj_query_1_evidence.run: re-run on our ARM build host of the h2h XERJ-Query arm, same binary (~/blog_measure/bin/xerj, rc.101 tree), bundle candidate_a_s47_2026-11-04, verify decline_v2, 4 cores; final status and answer equal the 2026-11-05 run on 160/160
xerj_query_1_evidence.note: counting answers cite no records by design (final_evidence_ids is [] on every counting answer: docs/FACTS_API.md on origin/main)
